optimization_analysis: Three reductions applied: (1) CLAWBACK's two sequential SEM_FILTERs are merged into one combined predicate, saving one LLM call per document that passes the first filter. (2) All three SEM_EXTRACT calls are updated to request a canonical/normalized legal company name, which makes company identity consistent across branches and lets the two SEM_JOINs be replaced with deterministic exact JOINs—eliminating LLM cost that scales with join-input sizes. (3) The 70-subsidiary threshold is pushed into the SUBSIDIARIES SEM_FILTER so documents with obviously fewer subsidiaries are dropped before the more expensive SEM_EXTRACT step; the scalar FILTER(subsidiary_count >= 70) is retained after extraction to preserve correctness against any LLM miscounts.

optimized_semantic_plan.program: SOX = SCAN_DOCS(CONTRACTEXHIBIT, all) -> SEM_FILTER('Is this a SOX Section 302 certification document?') -> SEM_EXTRACT('Extract the certified company normalized to its canonical legal name, and the certifying officer with title', {company: str, certifying_officer: str}) -> GROUP_BY(company, certifying_officers = SORT_ASC(DISTINCT(certifying_officer))); CLAWBACK = SCAN_DOCS(CONTRACTEXHIBIT, all) -> SEM_FILTER('Is this a clawback or compensation-recovery policy that permits recovery for misconduct?') -> SEM_EXTRACT('Extract the company normalized to its canonical legal name and normalize the covered-person category to a standard category label', {company: str, covered_person_category: str}) -> DEDUP(company, covered_person_category); SUBSIDIARIES = SCAN_DOCS(CONTRACTEXHIBIT, all) -> SEM_FILTER('Is this a subsidiary-list filing that lists 70 or more subsidiaries?') -> SEM_EXTRACT('Extract the parent company normalized to its canonical legal name and the exact count of listed subsidiaries', {company: str, subsidiary_count: integer}) -> FILTER(subsidiary_count >= 70) -> GROUP_BY(company, largest_subsidiary_count = MAX(subsidiary_count)); JOIN(SOX, CLAWBACK, on=company) -> JOIN(SUBSIDIARIES, on=company) -> ORDER_BY(largest_subsidiary_count DESC, company ASC)
